value.signature: fn content_commitment (id : & ActId , proposal : & ProposalCommitment , host_content_blinding_value : & SecretSlice < u8 > , content : & ContentPreDigest ,) -> Result < ContentCommitment , ProfileError >

review.body: { host_blinding_value_format (host_content_blinding_value) ? ; let digest = hash (CONTENT_RECIPE , "PN-content-v2" , vec ! [public (identifier (id)) , anchor (proposal) ?, SecretValue :: Bytes (host_content_blinding_value . clone ()) , received (id , content) ?,] ,) ? ; Ok (ContentCommitment { recipe : CONTENT_RECIPE . into () , bytes : publish (& digest) ? , }) }
review.item_premise: The public body, identity and final commitments are recorded completely. Content pairs, both author blinding values and host blinding values, dependency lists and pre-digests stay in secrecy carriers with redacted Debug; only the admitted final residues, representation refusals and explicit carriage-equality result leave their inventoried boundaries. No entropy, freshness or authority is inferred.
